race.description: Warren Turner Electrical Country Boosted Hcp (C1)
race.comment: LIGHTENING KISS (4) has made the right start to her career, placing at this track on debut after being slow away before putting a Scone Maiden away by just under three lengths as a dominant odds-on favourite. The first try at around 1280m is the question, but her soft-track record and upside make her the one to beat. MODERNIST (6) comes back from a provincial fourth at Newcastle and her previous run was a decisive Maiden win at this track and distance. Brings the most relevant proven 1280m form. Main danger. ABOVE BOARD (7) earned his Class 1 chance with a Wellington Maiden win and had excuses when fifth at Dubbo prior, though his one previous try around 1280m was unplaced. CAPE COD (1) resumes from five months off after a strong Scone Maiden win and has had the two trials in readiness for this. Well bred mare expected to go close.
